__broaden__.αἵματος: αἷμα — blood; neut. gen. sg., with ἆσσον ’nearer to’ · also neut. gen. sg. of descent, after εἰμί: ’of (our) blood’ (ἐμός ἐσσι καὶ αἵματος ἡμετέροιο ’you are mine and of our blood’) · also neut. gen. sg. of the stuff filled with or smeared with: ’with blood’ (κνίσης τε καὶ αἵματος ἐμπλήσαντες; στῆθος … φύρσω αἵματος)
__broaden__.γένηται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ἄν/κε: ’shall come’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a direct question of doubt/deliberation, no ἄν/κε: τί … γένηται; ’what is to happen?’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., prospective in a negative statement with a relative clause: οὐδὲ γένηται ’nor ever shall there be’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a general relative clause without ἄν/κε: ’whatever shall come to pass’ (ὅσσα γένηται) · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a fear clause after μή: ’lest it become’ (μή … ἕλωρ … γένηται ’lest it become prey’) · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in an indirect clause after ὅπως: ’(consider) how it may turn out’ (ὅπως ὄχ’ ἄριστα γένηται) · also aor. subj. 3 sg. with κε, in a conditional or relative clause: ’shall prove, become’ (ὁππότερος … κε νικήσῃ κρείσσων τε γένηται; αἴ κέν … γένηται)
__broaden__.γένοιο: γίγνομαι — become; aor. opt. 2 sg. mid.: ’you might become’, in a wish (εἰ … γένοιο ’if only you could become’) · also aor. opt. 2 sg. mid. in a negative wish: ’may you not become’ (μήτ’ εἴης … μήτε γένοιο)
__broaden__.εἴης: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 2 sg.: ’you would be’ · also in a negative wish: ’may you not be’ (μήτ’ εἴης)
__broaden__.δόμεναι: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεναι, used as imperative: ’give’ · also inf. after ὀτρύνω, ’to give’ (πομπὴν ὀτρύνω δόμεναι ’I urge (him) to give a conveyance’) · also inf. complementing an impersonal ’it seemed better’: ’to give’ (κέρδιον εἶναι … δόμεναι ’better to give’) · also inf. after the impersonal χρή: ’to give’ (σε χρὴ δόμεναι ’you ought to give’) · also inf. complementing ἔτλης: ’to bring oneself to give’ · also inf. after φθονέω: ’(do not) begrudge giving’ (οὔτε τινὰ φθονέω δόμεναι)
__broaden__.δώῃ: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg. (= Attic δῷ), after αἴ κε: ’may grant’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a general relative clause, without κε: ’gives, is to give’ (οἵ τ’ … βῶσιν καί σφι Ζεὺς … δώῃ) · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a prospective relative clause with κε: ’who shall give’ (ὅς κ’ … τάμῃσι … δώῃ)
__broaden__.θέτο: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’set (for himself)’ · also in tmesis with ἀπό (ἀπὸ … θέτο = ἀπέθετο): ’put off, laid aside’ · also with a name as object: ’gave, bestowed (a name)’ (τὸ γὰρ θέτο … μήτηρ ’his mother gave him that’)
__broaden__.λίποι: λείπω — leave, abandon; aor. opt. 3 sg., wish: ’may it leave’ · also in a purpose/result clause after ὥς: ’so that it should leave’ (ὥς μιν ψυχὴ λίποι)
__broaden__.μέλε: μέλω — be a care to (someone); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔμελε(ν)), + dat.: ’was a care to’ · also μέλος — limb; neut. acc. pl., elided (μέλε’ = μέλεα)
__broaden__.τάων: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic τῶν): ’of these/those women’ · also fem. gen. pl., partitive, of things just named: ’of these’ (τάων ἥν κ’ ἐθέλῃσιν ’whichever of these he wishes’)
__broaden__.χείλεα: χεῖλος — lip, rim, brim; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted · also neut. acc. pl., object: ’lips’ (στῆθος καὶ χείλεα φύρσω ’I will smear your chest and lips’)
__broaden__.ἄγον: ἄγω — lead, bring, take along; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγον): ’I took along’ · also impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, with ἐκ in tmesis (ἐκ … ἄγον = ἐξῆγον): ’they led out, carried off’ · also impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they led, brought’ (ἄγον ζώσαντες)
__broaden__.ἄνα: ἄναξ — lord, master; voc. sg., shortened epic form: ’lord!’ · also ἀνά (ἄνα) — up!; adv./interjection used as an imperative: ’up! get up!’ (ἀλλ’ ἄνα)
__broaden__.ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’) · also + dat., of time: ’in, within’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a day’) · also + acc., ’in pursuit of, after’ (ἐπ’ ἀγροτέρας ’after wild (goats)’) · also + dat., ’in favour of, on behalf of’ (ἐπ’ Ἴρῳ ἦρα φέρων ’showing favour to Irus’)
__broaden__.ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + dat., ’in charge of, over’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσιν ’over my possessions’) · also + dat., of purpose: ’for’ (ἐπὶ δόρπῳ ’for supper’)
__broaden__.ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its noun with anastrophe: ἑοῖς ἔπι ’upon his own (possessions)’ · also + gen., postpositive with anastrophe, of direction: ’toward’ (νήσου ἔπι Ψυρίης ’toward the island of Psyria’) · also as adverb with no case expressed, intensifying repetition: ’besides, again’ (ἔπι δεύτερον αὖτις ’a second time, once more’) · also = ἔπεστι, accented on the first syllable when it stands for the verb: ’there is (upon)’ · also as preverb in tmesis, placed after its object: ἔπι … ὦρσεν = ἐπῶρσεν ’stirred up (against)’ · also + gen., postpositive with anastrophe, of place: ’on, upon’ (οὐδοῦ ἔπι ξεστοῦ ’on the polished threshold’)

(epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’ · also ’before’ after a verb of anticipating (ἔφθης … ἢ ἐγώ ’you got here before I did’) · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἔτι … ἦέ τις ’whether still … or someone’) · also ’than’ after a verb of preferring: βουλοίμην … ἢ … ἀνάσσειν ’I would rather … than rule’ · also introducing the first alternative of a deliberation: ’whether … or’ (ἢ ἐλάσει’ … ἦέ μιν ἦκ’ ἐλάσειε)

__broaden__.ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic με (ὥς με κελεύεις ’as you bid me’) · also postpositive after its noun, comparative ’like’ (οἰωνῶν ὥς ’like birds’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τοι (ὥς τοι ἐγὼν ἐρέω ’as I shall tell you’) · also correlative ’so’ answering ὅπως, introducing a wish with the opt., accented before the enclitic τοι: ’so may’ (ὥς τοι Ζεὺς τελέσειεν ’so may Zeus fulfil it for you’) · also with a plain subj. __broaden__.αὖθ: αὖθι (elided αὖθ’) — here, on the spot, right here; adv. (distinct from αὖτε/αὖ ’again, in turn’) · also = αὖτε ’again, in turn’, marking the next item of a series (χωρὶς δ’ αὖθ’ ἕρσαι ’and again separately, the youngest’) · also with αἰεί, ’hereafter, henceforth’ (αἰεὶ αὖθ’ ἡμῖν μεταδαίσεται ’always hereafter he shall feast among us’)
__broaden__.μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’ · also negating a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that … not’ (ἵνα μή τι … ἀλγήσετε ’so that you may not suffer’) · also with the optative, a negative wish: ’may … not’ (μή … ἀντιβολήσαις) · also ὡς ἂν μή + subj., negative purpose: ’so that … not’ (ὡς ἂν μή σε κατατρύχῃ ’so that he may not wear you out’) · also + subj. giving the content of an oath, ’that no one …’ (ὀμόσσατε … μή τις … πλήξῃ ’swear that no one strike’)
